maddeler.e:
افترضن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَضْنَ (iftaraḍna) /if.ta.radˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# اُفْتُرِضْنَ (ufturiḍna) /uf.tu.ridˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# اِفْتَرِضْنَ (iftariḍna) /if.ta.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
